subject.title: RFC: add local adaptive-refresh replay tooling

question: After the policy source is unified, should CodexBar permanently expose and maintain AdaptiveReplayKit and AdaptiveReplayCLI as public SwiftPM products?
rationale: The merged adaptive-refresh decision approved an opt-in runtime mode and an evidence gate, but it did not establish ownership of a new standalone library and executable product surface.

options.title: Sponsor shared-policy tooling
options.body: Accept the offline replay products after they consume the same canonical policy implementation as the app.

options.title: Accept mirrored products
options.body: Own the current public products and the ongoing synchronization burden of parallel policy implementations.

options.title: Keep tooling external
options.body: Use the replay harness outside main rather than expanding CodexBar's supported package surface.

recommendation.title: Sponsor shared-policy tooling
recommendation.body: Accept the offline replay products after they consume the same canonical policy implementation as the app.

likelyOwner.reason: Repository product-surface ownership is the unresolved choice, and current release integration provides the strongest available decision-routing signal.
